verdict.rationale: OpenAI publishes a dedicated per-model comparison page listing context window, max output tokens, and supported endpoints for each model (gpt-supp-models-compare), backed by a pricing page giving exact per-1M-token prices per model (gpt-supp-pricing) and a changelog that states precise figures like a 1M-token context window for specific models (gpt-supp-capability-flags). A rate-limits guide further documents how token budgets interact with rate limits and caching. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that these documented limits match actual API behavior, and no raw example of the table's exact numeric contents in the evidence pack.
